# hpe_morpheus_network_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_type" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_type" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network type
- `name` (String) The name of the network type

### Read-Only

- `can_assign_pool` (Boolean) Whether a network pool can be assigned to this network type
- `category` (String) The category of the network type
- `cidr_editable` (Boolean) Whether the CIDR field is editable
- `cidr_required` (Boolean) Whether the CIDR field is required
- `code` (String) The code identifier of the network type
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether networks of this type can be created
- `deletable` (Boolean) Whether networks of this type can be deleted
- `description` (String) A description of the network type
- `dhcp_server_editable` (Boolean) Whether the DHCP server setting is editable
- `dns_editable` (Boolean) Whether DNS settings are editable
- `external_type` (String) The external type identifier
- `gateway_editable` (Boolean) Whether the gateway field is editable
- `has_cidr` (Boolean) Whether the network type supports CIDR notation
- `has_floating_ips` (Boolean) Whether the network type supports floating IPs
- `has_network_server` (Boolean) Whether the network type has an associated network server
- `has_static_routes` (Boolean) Whether the network type supports static routes
- `name_editable` (Boolean) Whether the network name is editable
- `network_domain_editable` (Boolean) Whether the network domain is editable
- `overlay` (Boolean) Whether this is an overlay network type
- `static_override_editable` (Boolean) Whether the static override setting is editable
- `vlan_id_editable` (Boolean) Whether the VLAN ID is editable
